panels.art: Tight medium shot: Dan's hand freezes an inch from the iron handle; Mira's gloved fist clamps his wrist. The knocking has stopped. The System window hangs in the corner of the frame, its border brightening. Warm ochre lamp light, deep shadows.

lines.ru: Дэн отдёргивает руку. Это его первое решение в Башне — и он принял его сам. За дверью всё стихает.

lines.en: That is not me. I stop.
lines.ru: Это не я. Я не открою.
lines.delivery: shaky but resolved, catching his breath, pulling his hand back from the door
crisp flat system notification, neutral and exact
dry and low, grudging approval, the closest thing to praise she gives

panels.art: Close-up of the ceiling lamp: the flame has shrunk to a tiny ember with a faint vermilion heart; Mira kneels below it checking her backpack, Dan watches the light with worry. The room is noticeably darker, teal shadows creeping up the walls.

lines.ru: Лампа догорает. Слово, которое в ней жило, выгорает. Скоро в комнате не останется света.

lines.en: The light is small. Soon it is gone.
lines.ru: Свет слабеет. Скоро его не будет.
lines.delivery: quiet, tired and practical, watching the tiny flame, warning in a low voice
hopeful and eager, a short question, ready to move
brisk, low and businesslike, calling him closer to the map

panels.art: Top-down insert on the floor: a worn hand-drawn map of the floor spread between Dan's and Mira's knees, a long winding path, a hall, and a big arch marked with a vermilion cross (lettering added later); Mira's finger traces the route.

lines.ru: Мира расстилает на полу потрёпанную карту. Этаж огромен. В конце пути — Ворота, а за ними Зал Слов, где, возможно, лежит имя Дэна.

lines.en: This is the gate. The gate hears names.
lines.delivery: serious and quiet, pointing at a map, patient instructor tone

lines.en: I have no name. Can I go?
lines.ru: У меня нет имени. Могу я пройти?
lines.delivery: uncertain and honest, a gentle self-aware question

lines.en: I have a plan. It is a bad plan.
lines.ru: У меня есть план. Он плохой.
lines.delivery: deadpan, flat and a little dark humor, admitting the odds

panels.art: Epic wide establishing shot of a vast colonnade hall of pale stone pillars in ash-grey light; dozens of tall Silent stand motionless along both walls, heads tilted toward the sound of the heroes' steps. Dan and Mira tiny at the entrance, hand in hand.

lines.ru: Зал Слушающих. Десятки Безмолвных стоят вдоль стен. Они слепы. Но они слышат, как падает пылинка.

lines.en: Take my hand. Listen and go slowly.
lines.ru: Возьми меня за руку. Слушай и иди медленно.
lines.delivery: hushed urgent whisper, tense and focused, guiding him through a silent army

lines.en: I can go slowly. I am very good at it.
lines.ru: Медленно я могу. У меня отлично получается.
lines.delivery: whispered, nervous humor, steady self-mockery to calm his own fear

panels.art: Low-angle over-the-shoulder shot: a row of Silent heads in the foreground, blank faces tilted, Dan and Mira creeping past in the background along the wall; Dan staring up at them with a nervous half-smile.

lines.en: I can count ten. No, more. More!
lines.ru: Я вижу десять. Нет, больше. Ещё!
lines.delivery: tiny awed whisper, counting in panic and then trailing off in dread

lines.en: Do not look at them. Look down.
lines.ru: Не смотри на них. Смотри вниз.
lines.delivery: sharp low whisper, urgent and controlled, an order given without moving her lips

panels.art: Close-up on Dan crouching, a palm-sized stone in his hand, his eyes tracing the hall's far corner; Mira beside him raises one eyebrow. A tiny engineer's grin on his face.

lines.en: Mira. I have a plan too.
lines.ru: Мира. У меня тоже есть план.
lines.delivery: quiet excited whisper, an idea sparking, a boyish grin hiding in the voice
suspicious and flat, low whisper, bracing for a bad idea

lines.en: A stone. A far wall. Listen.
lines.delivery: soft confident whisper, the engineer explaining a trick

lines.ru: Они слепы. Значит, их можно обмануть звуком. Дэн замахивается и бросает камень в дальний угол.

panels.art: Wide motion shot: the stone arcs through the air; across the hall every Silent head swings together toward the far corner like a field of turned flowers; Dan and Mira slip along the opposite wall, almost smiling.

lines.en: Not bad. Not bad at all.
lines.delivery: stunned, breathless whisper, reluctant admiration as the trick works

lines.en: I know walls. Now I know halls.
lines.ru: Я знаю стены. Теперь знаю залы.
lines.delivery: quiet satisfied pride, a small smile in his voice, proud of his clever trick

panels.art: Dramatic close-up of Dan's sneaker as it cracks a loose tile; ripple rings of vermilion sound radiate across the floor; behind him, every Silent head snaps back toward him in a perfect line. Dan's eyes widen.

lines.delivery: panicked frantic whisper, horrified apology after a mistake

panels.art: Hero shot, low angle: Mira, arm outstretched, glowing vermilion lettering exploding from her mouth in a shockwave ring (lettering added later) that freezes the Silent mid-step; her face drains of colour, a thin vermilion thread trails from her lips.

lines.delivery: thundering commanding shout, powerful and raw, a shockwave of will
amazed, breathless, awe and relief, startled by her power

lines.en: Not for long. Take my hand!
lines.delivery: strained and winded, gasping urgency, pulling him onward

panels.art: Dynamic diagonal shot: Mira stumbling, knees buckling, pale, vermilion thread dripping from her lips; Dan hauls her arm over his shoulder and drags her toward the far exit arch; frozen Silent around them twitch, thawing.

lines.delivery: weak, gasping and breathless, voice running out, admitting defeat

lines.en: Now you take my hand, Mira.
lines.ru: Теперь ты возьми мою руку, Мира.
lines.delivery: tender determined reply, steady and warm, helping her up

lines.ru: Впервые за всю ночь Дэн тянет Миру, а не она его.

panels.art: Medium shot at the exit arch: a worn fresco on the wall shows two girls holding hands, one wearing a red cord on her wrist; Mira stops dead in front of it, her eyes wide, her own wrist cord in frame; Dan looks from the fresco to her.

lines.ru: У выхода из зала — старая фреска. Две девочки держатся за руки. У одной на запястье красная нить. У Миры на запястье такая же.

lines.delivery: curious, gentle, looking at a faded painting, softly asking

lines.en: No one. Go. Look at the gate.
lines.delivery: closed off and curt, hurt hidden under a flat voice, changing the subject

panels.art: Monumental low-angle wide shot: a house-high stone gate without handle or lock fills the frame, a single long line of faint vermilion lettering carved above the arch (lettering added later); cold teal shadow pools at the base; Dan and Mira tiny at its feet.

lines.ru: Ворота. Каменные, высотой с дом. Ни ручки, ни замка. Только строка над аркой.

lines.delivery: loud hopeful shout at the huge gate, a little theatrical and desperate

lines.en: The gate hears names. Not doors.
lines.delivery: cold flat system voice, a dry correction, mild mockery

panels.art: Medium three-shot at the foot of the gate: the System window glows a harder vermilion; Dan clutches his head trying to remember, Mira grips his shoulder, urging.

lines.en: The gate wants a name. Say yours.
lines.delivery: calm cold system instruction, patient and a little ominous
panicked and strained, head in his hands, voice cracking with despair
urgent forceful shout, fierce and pleading, pushing him to try

panels.art: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Dan and Mira: far down the hall, a single tall Silent walks toward them in a straight calm line, its pale face catching the light; Mira's back stiffens, Dan turns, horrified.

lines.ru: Позади — шаги. Не толпа. Один. Он идёт спокойно, как тот, кто знает дорогу.

lines.delivery: hushed alarmed whisper, tense, her eyes on the approaching Silent

lines.en: That is the Silent! It has my name!
lines.ru: Это тот Безмолвный! У него моё имя!
lines.delivery: shocked and breathless whisper, realization dawning, the thief of his name

panels.art: Wide shot: the Silent stands in front of the gate and speaks; the vermilion line above the arch flares bright; Dan and Mira press themselves against the arch's side wall, caught between gate and Silent.

lines.delivery: hollow smooth monotone, flat and eerie, stolen name spoken in a dead voice

lines.ru: Ворота вздрагивают. Они слышат имя. Украденное имя, сказанное чужим ртом.

panels.art: Action shot: the gate splits down the middle, light flooding out; the Silent steps through, calm; Dan and Mira dash into the closing gap right behind it, Dan's glasses flying off his nose, Mira's scarf whipping.

lines.delivery: furious outraged shout, hurt and incredulous at seeing his name walk away
sharp urgent shout, pulling him to run, adrenaline

panels.art: Almost entirely black frame: only a low amber candle lights the lower half of a hooded man's face, a pale thin calm smile, ink-stained fingertips folded; on the edges of the dark, two silhouettes, Dan and Mira, standing small.

lines.ru: Грохот. Темнота. И тихий довольный голос. Кто-то ждал их здесь.

lines.delivery: calm velvety unsettling welcome, smooth and slow, courteous with a chilling smile
soft knowing purr, polite and amused, a quiet barbed greeting
confused and wary, a small stunned question, glancing at Mira

grammarNote.title: Приказ и глагол can
grammarNote.body: Приказ в английском — это просто глагол без подлежащего: «Look!», «Take my hand!», «Go!». Чтобы запретить, добавляем do not: «Do not look». Глагол can значит «мочь, уметь» и никогда не меняется: «I can go», «She can stop them». Отрицание — can't (можно также can not, но в речи почти всегда can't). Вопрос получается перестановкой: «Can we go?».

quiz.q: Что решил сделать Дэн, когда голос за дверью просил открыть?
Как Дэн отвлёк Безмолвных в зале?
Какое слово крикнула Мира, чтобы остановить Безмолвных?
